svg.title: Psychedelic Policy Reform. Religious freedom for sincere sacramental practice, seen from Pennsylvania.
svg.desc: A quiet docket page behind a stone arch. Light travels along its stones from both sides to a golden keystone, each stone catching the light as it passes, and the keystone glows as it arrives; a few motes rise through the arch: an open record and evidence library about the Religious Freedom Restoration Act. Not legal advice.
